what: CM1 r21.1's own hurricane in the rings GM1's hurricane pictures draw: its run of the 8 km hurricane preset's settings with its own adaptive time step (GM1-HURRICANE-RUNS.json runs.cm1-8km), each saved time read by cm1core.quicklook.azimuthal as GM1's frames are: rings one grid spacing wide around the smoothed lowest pressure at the lowest level; the swirling (tangential) wind and the warm core (ring-mean potential temperature minus its mean over the rings 300 to 450 km out), by ring and level, for the rings out to one past 300 km and the levels to the first above 20 km
provenance: CM1 r21.1 (cm1.exe built from the release, OpenMP, on a CPU), its one-file netCDF history saved every 3 hours to hour 96 (measured)
made_by: tools/generate_hurricane_rings.py from the run's cm1out.nc (neither is in the wheel)
